description: All gallery images have an infrared red tint filter applied

filter.note: Warm red/infrared color tint applied to all gallery images. Inspired by space telescope infrared imaging (JWST, Spitzer). Artistic filter, not scientific false-color.

video_filter.note: Warm, bright res-light CSS filter applied to the Artemis II earthrise/earthset hero video.

gif_filter.source: SPCX official Starship V3 propellant-transfer render — https://www.spacex.com/updates/starship-v3 (CMS asset Prop_Transfer_4K, https://sxcontent9668.azureedge.us/cms-assets/assets/Prop_Transfer_4_K_83ce127002.mp4). Depicts two Starship V3 vehicles docked side-by-side, leeward-to-leeward, in LEO. © SPCX; used here editorially with red-tint filter applied.
gif_filter.motion: Native render motion — docking sequence, source segment 16.5s–24.5s
gif_filter.encode: ffmpeg -ss 16.5 -t 8, fps=10, 80 frames, scale=560, max_colors=48, bayer dither scale=5, colorchannelmixer rr=1.4:gg=0.55:bb=0.45
gif_filter.note: Red tint baked into GIF frames at encode time. Real SPCX V3 render (not a fan/AI render). Poster still: starship-v3-prop-transfer.jpg (frame ~t+24s). Replaced earlier propellant-transfer assets (starship-spine-to-spine.gif/.jpg with unverified provenance, and the aft-to-aft fan render starship-refuel-loop.gif), which were deleted in cleanup.

convention: All new images added to this gallery MUST have this filter applied before committing
